text.en: Add 1 "Harpie" monster from your Deck to your hand, then if only your opponent controls a monster, you can Special Summon 1 "Harpie Lady", or 1 monster that mentions it, from your hand or GY. You can banish this card from your GY; Fusion Summon 1 EARTH or WIND Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, using monsters from your hand or field. You can only use each effect of "Elegant Tri-Mirror" once per turn.
text.zh-CN: 此卡名的①②效果1回合仅可各使用1次。①：从牌组将1只“神鹰”怪兽加入手牌。仅有对手场上才存在怪兽的情况下，进而可从自己手牌・墓地将1只“神鹰女郎”或记载有该卡名的怪兽特殊召唤。②：将墓地的此卡除外可以发动。将自己手牌・场上的怪兽作为融合素材，将1只风・地属性融合怪兽融合召唤。
